name: HotpotQA
description: HotpotQA is a question answering dataset featuring diverse, multi-hop questions with supporting facts to enable more explainable question answering systems. Models must find and reason over multiple Wikipedia documents to answer questions, rather than relying on single-sentence retrieval.
